title: Unit fixtures mkdtemp into the temp ROOT, and a shared scratch root breaks gif-make
description: Split from MPI-810, which shipped the registry half. Six unit fixtures leave project-shaped folders directly under %TEMP% (1042 by 2026-09-18). The obvious fix - one shared scratch root - was written and backed out: it makes gif-make fail '.meta directory missing' after gif-frames has run, serially, mechanism unknown.
